description: This file defines the ValidatorActionFilter class, which implements an ASP.NET Core action filter to validate model state before executing an action. If the model state is invalid, it returns a JSON response with validation errors and sets the HTTP status code to 422.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core action filter for validating model state and returning error details in JSON format if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the incoming model state is valid. If not, constructs a JSON response with validation errors, sets the response status to 422, and prevents the action execution.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: An empty implementation of the IActionFilter interface's method, does nothing after the action executes.
